text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, seriously?! Neo Universe is 
entering the Takarazuka Kinen?!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, for a key contender for the Classic 
Triple Crown to start their challenge with 
the Nippon Derby... There's almost no 
precedent for that, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Neo Universe's bold decision sent waves 
of excitement through the Spring Twinkle 
Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was searching for excitement. And 
Neo Universe was no different.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Things are differentâfrom before, 
aren't they? Our 'fellow passenger,' that 
is."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Races where Senior Class veterans gather 
feature a completely different lineup from 
the Classic road.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the prime example catching everyone's 
eye is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Conquering both Grand Prix in spring and 
autumn— I will carry it out without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Last year's Umamusume of the Year. The 
cold, calculating mission executor, 
Symboli Kris S. And—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's show them a fierce tap dance! To the 
champion, and to the rising stars who dare 
challenge us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The vibrant, ultra-positive Umamusume, Tap 
Dance City. With powerful steps, she has 
charged her way onto the grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Thrilling," huh... Out of all of them, 
the Umamusume who excites me the most 
is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe looks toward the edge of the 
stage. And there...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well~, sure, I was able to win both the 
Kikuka Sho and the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
but~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Felt like I was super duper lucky~. Well, 
I'll still do my best this time too, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that Umamusume is the one the 
three of us watched together last year...
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's Hishi Miracle for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her miraculous victory in last year's 
Kikuka Sho, she was truly a child of 
miracles.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle... Invisible "OZSR" 
traction...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Today, I don't just want to be an 
"onlooker"... I want to do some "lunar 
sampling"...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What does that mean~? I'm not that 
great with literature stuff~...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Also, Neo Universe has one more thing she 
wants to do...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
An eclipsing binary star... The other side 
of a binary system. That is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: That Umamusume knows...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Muha~☆ A paradise of top Umamusume-chans!! 
This place is truly Heaven of Heavens!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha, WHAT is it? I'm not suspicious 
AT ALL! I'm a runner in this race, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so glad I've kept racing all this 
time~ To think I get to witness the Spring 
Dream Race right from the officials' 
seats♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
‘Agnes Digital.’ An all-rounder regardless 
of turf or dirt, and an Umamusume who 
loves Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what Neo Universe finds so 
captivating about Agnes Digital, but she 
definitely seems to have caught her 
interest.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen... it's amazing, 
isn't it...? Seven-colored 'gravity' and 
'repulsion' acting upon one another...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――A "Feast of the Stars." In this 
unfamiliar outer cosmos, today, Neo 
Universe...
